content.short: NBA TopShot is a basketball-focused NFT marketplace.
content.description: NBA TopShot is a leading NFT marketplace for basketball fans, offering a curated catalog of officially licensed NBA digital collectibles. It is the only basketball NFT marketplace selling products officially sanctioned by the National Basketball Association, ensuring verifiable ownership of unique moments. The platform highlights short clips of historic or iconic plays and milestones, transforming basketball highlights into collectible items. It has cataloged moments from many famous players, including LeBron James, giving fans a tangible link to the game’s most memorable moments.
